import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds (Primary Breed)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars1 = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 100, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Gender Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
gender_counts = df.groupby('SexHundLang')['AnzHunde'].sum()
colors_gender = ['#66b3ff', '#ff9999']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_gender,
                                    explode=[0.02, 0.02], shadow=True)
ax2.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(district_counts))
bars3 = ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Registrations by District', fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=8)

# 4. Owner Age Group Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Sort by the AlterV10Sort to get proper age order
owner_age = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['AlterV10Lang', 'AlterV10Sort'])[['AlterV10Lang', 'AlterV10Sort']]
owner_age = owner_age.sort_values('AlterV10Sort')
age_order = owner_age['AlterV10Lang'].tolist()

owner_counts = df.groupby('AlterV10Lang')['AnzHunde'].sum()
owner_counts = owner_counts.reindex(age_order)
colors_age = sns.color_palette('plasma', len(owner_counts))
bars4 = ax4.bar(range(len(owner_counts)), owner_counts.values, color=colors_age)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(owner_counts)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(owner_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group')
ax4.set_title('Dog Ownership by Owner Age Group', fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.93)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
